note: M101 template joins (Auditor #491 ruling: a DSL form is used only with >= 10 replaying upstream evidence entries). 36 exported pure functions from 27 permissive repos outside the corpus and the ext-manifest, mined the M99 way: the upstream function run in an empty vm on a fixed grid, every 3rd row (at most 14) as training, extended by the engine's own questions answered from upstream (addedForGates), the rest held out; far probes past the grid checked too, and char probes (each string parameter at "a" + c + "b" for every printable ASCII non-alphanumeric c). Excluded: any held/far/char-probe miss, number formatting outside the integer domain (toFixed, parseFloat, Math.*, toLocaleString, Intl), duplicates of an M99 entry or of another upstream, more than 3 per repo (M99 included), more than 2 per expression shape. Each expression is re-derived from the recorded examples alone by the engine with the form on and is right on every held-out and far row. forms counts the entries whose derived program uses the form; peaceai/lib/derive.ts TEMPLATE_FORM_EVIDENCE must equal it. No third-party code is run by the test.
